READY before attack: WEST facing LEFT, camera near anatomical LEFT hand holds BELL at waist and forward, far RIGHT hand holds FIVE red talismans close to chest. Compact separated feet, knees soft, upright torso.

ANTICIPATION begins, WEST facing LEFT. Weight shifts onto rear anatomical LEFT leg toward screen RIGHT, pelvis lowers slightly. Far anatomical RIGHT fan arm draws backward toward right ribs behind torso; its upper arm hidden. Near LEFT bell arm moves modestly forward toward screen LEFT overlapping torso. Leading RIGHT foot light. Keep props attached to their same shoulders.

DEEP WINDUP, WEST facing LEFT: Far RIGHT talisman hand drawn behind waist toward screen RIGHT, far shoulder/upper arm occluded by torso; show fan raised just behind rear elbow without swapping to near shoulder. NEAR LEFT bell arm swings forward toward screen LEFT in front of torso for balance. Weight over deeply bent rear LEFT leg, leading RIGHT foot poised to step left. Torso coils back slightly.

FORWARD STEP into strike, WEST facing LEFT: anatomical RIGHT foot steps toward screen LEFT and heel comes down, rear LEFT toe begins push. FAR RIGHT fan hand travels forward from waist with elbow only HALF unfolded at lower chest, not full contact. NEAR LEFT bell arm counters toward rear screen RIGHT, always connected to near visible shoulder. A distinct intermediate acceleration pose.

ACCELERATION before contact, WEST facing LEFT. Front RIGHT knee bends over planted front foot, rear LEFT leg extends back. FAR RIGHT fan elbow still slightly bent, fan at front shoulder line reaching left. NEAR LEFT bell moves back toward screen RIGHT. Hips lean toward target, cloth lags. Keep two visible separately articulated legs.

FOLLOW THROUGH after contact, WEST facing LEFT. FAR RIGHT fan sweeps forward and down a little toward screen LEFT, elbow softens. Near LEFT bell remains back but bends inward. Torso low over RIGHT front leg, rear LEFT foot begins gathering. Preserve first image camera/scale with independent changing joints.

BRAKING, WEST facing LEFT. FAR RIGHT elbow bends and fan comes toward chest, NEAR LEFT bell elbow begins returning forward. Both knees bend; pull rear LEFT foot inward a little. Torso begins rising from lunge. Hands and elbows change while props stay in original hands.

RECOVERY, WEST facing LEFT. Torso half upright, far RIGHT fan drawn to chest at bent elbow, near LEFT bell returns beside hip, rear LEFT foot steps inward to compact separated support. Cloth trails, face relaxes slightly.

SETTLE, WEST facing LEFT. Almost upright with slightly bent knees, FAR RIGHT fan lowers from chest toward waist, NEAR LEFT bell comes forward at low chest. Cloth and ponytail still lag a little. Same shoulder connections as READY.

LATE RECOVERY, WEST facing LEFT. Support balanced on separated feet, far RIGHT fan at lower chest and near LEFT bell at low front waist. Soft elbows, subtle breath, face fully toward left target. Almost ready, no arm swapping.

READY END, WEST facing LEFT. Final slight settling of knees/shoulders, far RIGHT fan held close to chest and near LEFT bell low forward, ribbons settle. Distinct freshly drawn pose from01 but smoothly compatible with it.
